title: Roll Volley Off Pop Up (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 138bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Ball pops up at the kitchen line
Roll volley off the pop-up, time to shine

[Verse 1]
Ball floats up above the net tape height
Paddle back low, load for the strike
Low to high swing, brush over the top
Roll volley off the pop-up, do not stop

Contact at net height or above
Low to high through the ball you love
Paddle face closed slightly at the touch
Roll volley topspin, not too much

[Pre-Chorus]
Low to high, face slightly closed
Contact at net, topspin exposed
Brush over the top, let it drop
Roll volley off the pop-up, do not stop

[Chorus]
Roll volley off the pop-up, low to high
Brush the top, let it fly
Contact at net height, face closed slight
Roll volley off the pop-up, done right

[Verse 2]
Why roll instead of flat on the pop-up ball
Flat drives long, topspin brings it to the wall
Roll volley keeps the ball inside the court
Roll volley off the pop-up, the smart report

[Bridge]
Bluey: She has read the pop-up, roll volley winner, what a shot
Trevor: The closed face and low to high path creates the topspin that lands the ball short
Michelle: Pop-up above the tape. Roll it. Brush over the top. Land it short.

[Chorus]
Roll volley off the pop-up, low to high
Brush the top, let it fly
Contact at net height, face closed slight
Roll volley off the pop-up, done right

[Outro]
Pop-up above the tape
Roll it
Brush over the top
Roll volley off the pop-up
